pin_policy.notes: Emit version = "X.Y.Z" for registry modules — never >= or ~> on module blocks. Provider may use ~> X.Y.0 (patch-only). Always commit .terraform.lock.hcl. Never terraform init -upgrade without reviewing the lock diff. Never change provider to >= (no ceiling).

terraform.notes: Ceiling avoids silent CI failures on older runners vs write-only attrs in newer module lines.

provider.notes: Patch-bounded 5.100.x only (<6). Do NOT loosen to >= 5.100 (no ceiling). Prefer .terraform.lock.hcl. Do not jump to provider 6 without https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/guides/version-6-upgrade (multi-region provider config and more). EC2 6 + ALB 10 required first.

vpc.notes: Exact pin 5.21.0. If using native aws_nat_gateway, set enable_nat_gateway=false here or you double-bill NAT and churn routes.

ec2_instance.notes: Exact pin 5.8.0. create_security_group is v6-only — forbidden. Open >= 5.8.0 would pull 6.x-requiring releases.

alb.notes: Exact pin 9.17.0. Stays on AWS provider 5.x. ALB name is VPC-suffixed (not a fixed regional name) so partial-apply orphans do not collide on retry.

security_group.notes: Exact pin. Prefer one of module vs security_group_native — do not manage the same SG both ways. Attribute names differ (module.security_group_id vs aws_security_group.x.id).

security_group_native.notes: Native SG used by enterprise compute slice. Do not also attach the security-group module to the same resource.

rds.notes: Exact pin 6.12.0 (module major, not AWS provider major).

elasticache.notes: Native Redis. Migrating to elasticache_module later needs moved {} / terraform state mv — not a drop-in address swap.

elasticache_module.notes: Future migration target only. Plan state surgery from aws_elasticache_cluster before enabling.

eip.notes: Elastic IP associate with EC2 or NAT.

nat_gateway.notes: Prefer VPC module enable_nat_gateway. If using native aws_nat_gateway, force VPC enable_nat_gateway=false — otherwise duplicate NAT + route churn.

s3_cloudfront.notes: Static site catalogue entry: private S3 origin + CloudFront CDN with origin access control.

cloudfront.notes: Listed CloudFront CDN service. Resolves to the same S3 + CloudFront static-site stack as s3_cloudfront.

s3_bucket.notes: Exact pin 4.11.0 for provider 5.x. Do not use >= 4.11.0 / 5.15.4 (aws >= 6.42).
